versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support description of the behavior Type: valid Description: The SW-Component Template must allow linking of the SW-Component to a formal description of its behavior. Rationale: "...components are in theory exchangeable as long as they implement the same logic and provide the same public communication..." Thus the functionality / logic of a SW-Component should be describable.. Use Case: Exchange / compatibility of SW-components Dependencies:  5 22 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 212: AUTOSAR_RS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Requirements on Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Supporting Material: 
